summary: CDT Environmental Technology Investment Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting results of an extraordinary general meeting held on July 28, 2026. Shareholders passed two resolutions: a special resolution to change the company's dual foreign name (pending Cayman Islands approval) and an ordinary resolution to increase authorized share capital from US$250,000 divided into 4,000,000 shares to US$31,250,000 divided into 500,000,000 shares. This is a routine corporate governance filing—a shareholder meeting outcome with name change and capital increase. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or activist event is involved. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16.
